user.title: Start Coway Local
user.description: This integration hosts the fan’s local services at the address below, which was detected automatically. Change it only if the fan cannot reach Home Assistant there, for example with Docker bridge networking. Reserve the address in your router: fans must be provisioned again if it changes. After setup, choose Configure → Add fan. Tested with AP-1022K only.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Home Assistant found **{name}** in Wi-Fi setup mode. Continue to give it your Wi-Fi details over Bluetooth and connect it to Coway Local.

This replaces the fan’s Coway cloud connection. Tested with AP-1022K only.

bluetooth_wifi.title: Wi-Fi for {name}
bluetooth_wifi.description:
Choose the 2.4 GHz network the fan should join. The list comes from the fan’s own scan. Home Assistant sends the password to the fan over Bluetooth and does not store it.

Tick **Scan again** and submit to refresh the list.

error.invalid_server: Enter a reachable IPv4 address, three different ports (1024–65535), and an HTTPS provisioning URL.
error.no_networks: The fan found no 2.4 GHz networks. Check that your router is nearby, then scan again.
error.wifi_failed: The fan could not join Wi-Fi: {error}. Check that the network is 2.4 GHz and the password is correct.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Coway Local server is needed. Use Configure to add another fan.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device does not advertise like a Coway fan in setup mode.
abort.hub_required: Set up Coway Local first (Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → Coway Local), then add the fan again.
abort.no_devices_found: No Coway fan in Wi-Fi setup mode is visible to Home Assistant’s Bluetooth adapters or ESPHome proxies. Hold the fan’s **Mode** button to enter setup mode, wait a few seconds, then try again.
abort.ble_not_found: Home Assistant can no longer reach the fan over Bluetooth: {error} Make sure it is in setup mode and near a connectable adapter or an ESPHome proxy with `active: true`.
abort.ble_not_coway: This device is not a compatible Coway fan in setup mode: {error}
abort.ble_timeout: {error} Put the fan back into setup mode and try again.
abort.ble_protocol: The fan sent an unexpected Bluetooth response: {error}
abort.wifi_failed: The fan could not join Wi-Fi: {error}. Put it back into setup mode and try again.
abort.provision_failed: Setup failed: {error}. Put the fan back into setup mode and try again.
abort.cannot_start_pairing: Could not start setup. Check that the local service is running, Home Assistant has a frontend URL, and there are fewer than eight active setup attempts.
abort.pairing_expired: Setup expired. Put the fan in setup mode and start again.
abort.pairing_interrupted: Setup was canceled or the local service stopped. Choose Add fan to start again.
abort.fan_ready:
**Fan ready**

Your fan is connected and ready to control in Home Assistant. You can close this dialog.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this fan is already in progress.

progress.bluetooth_connect:
Connecting to **{name}** over Bluetooth and asking it to scan for Wi-Fi networks. This uses any nearby Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, and can take up to a minute.

Keep the fan in Wi-Fi setup mode.
progress.bluetooth_provision:
Sending Wi-Fi settings for **{network}** to {name}. The fan joins Wi-Fi, downloads its credentials from Home Assistant, and connects to the local broker.

This can take up to **2 minutes**. Keep the fan in Wi-Fi setup mode and leave this dialog open.
progress.verify_connection:
Your Wi-Fi settings have been sent. Home Assistant is waiting for the fan to connect and confirm its initial settings.

This can take another **2 minutes**. Keep the fan powered on and leave this dialog open. Setup will finish automatically.

pairing.title: Bluetooth setup
pairing.description:
Bluetooth setup opens in a new tab. Use Chrome on a nearby Mac or Android device, keep the Coway app closed, and leave this dialog open. If the tab does not open, use the button below.

When setup finishes, you will return here automatically. Home Assistant will verify the fan’s connection and confirm its 3-week pre-filter cleaning interval. No Submit step is needed. The setup link expires in 15 minutes.

server.title: Server settings
server.description: Changing the advertised address or ports requires provisioning existing fans again. Reserve the host’s LAN address before setup. Changing settings restarts this integration.

host_changed.title: Home Assistant’s address changed
host_changed.description:
Coway Local told your fans to connect to {host}, but this machine no longer has that address, so the fans cannot reach Home Assistant.

Give the machine that address again, for example with a DHCP reservation in your router, and reload Coway Local. Otherwise set the new address under Coway Local → Configure → Server settings and provision each fan again.
